title: Ya Ali Adrikni

<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Ali e Murtaza aye mere Mushkil Kusha
Aiye imdad ko ab mere hajat rawa
Qatl hote hain Hussaini roz bejurmo khatam
Jis taraf bhi dekhe hain ban rahi hain Karbala
